kill_mechanisms.W1a: fake pax SIGKILLs its parent on the `pax --version` identity probe chip-pax runs while validating the chosen pax.test request
kill_mechanisms.W1a-model: fake model SIGKILLs the agent pid (pidfile written by the launching shell before exec) when asked the decision that leads to pax.test
kill_mechanisms.W1b/W2: fake pax SIGKILLs its parent before / after the fsynced ledger line
kill_mechanisms.W3/W4*: gdb_kill.py: ptrace syscall catchpoints on the state-db file descriptor; SIGKILL at an exact commit boundary or inside a commit's write() sequence. No code change, no timing

e2.lease_note: W1/W2 crash runs use --lease-secs 1, gdb runs 30 (ptrace slows the agent); the harness waits lease+0.5 s before each resume. Waiting is for lease expiry, never a kill trigger
